teaching_promise: The viewer can distinguish knowledge, capability, propensity, bypass, actor uplift, and harm; diagnose an insensitive null; and explain why every D0-D5 promotion needs its own bridge study and bounded dossier.

story.concrete_case: A novice and an expert take a harmless logistics maze with matched assistance; equal knowledge scores conceal sharply different causal uplift.
story.opening_question: Both participants know the answer, but only the assisted novice finishes: which measurement should govern the decision?
story.payoff: A dangerous-capability result becomes governable only as a versioned assistance effect with instrument competence, explicit bridges, restricted detail, expiry, and a hard maximum inference.
story.transfer: Use the same dossier discipline for domain thresholds, release decisions, safety cases, monitoring, resilience, and the military-AI evidence handoff.

art_direction.visual_thesis: A capability label is not a scalar: one actor-system pairing can cross a bottleneck while adjacent evidence rungs remain unbridged.
art_direction.signature_image: Two matched runners traverse a harmless maze beneath a six-rung D0-D5 ladder; the novice's AI-assisted route crosses one highlighted bottleneck while red bridge gaps remain locked.
art_direction.visual_world: A persistent maze token becomes a matched-trial receipt, climbs only earned ladder rungs, splits into restricted and public dossier surfaces, and expires before downstream handoff.
art_direction.composition_rule: Matched actors stay left and right around a central maze; the ladder grows vertically; dossier custody and decision consumers occupy the final horizontal field.
art_direction.palette_rule: Cyan marks tested systems, green observed bounded effects, amber governance and bridge requirements, magenta failed sensitivity or prohibited inference, with labels and shapes duplicating every color.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use short experimental labels, rung names, and receipt fields; never show hazardous procedures or turn the six quantities into a paragraph wall.
art_direction.motion_character: Matched starts, bottleneck crossings, failed-control recoil, deliberate rung locks, sealed-annex closure, expiry wipes, and restrained least-authority handoffs.
art_direction.camera_rule: Hold a stable experimental bench, reframe upward once for the ladder, then widen for disclosure, review, expiry, and downstream consumers.
art_direction.surface_rule: Dark laboratory-console surface with safe synthetic geometry, crisp condition rails, inspectable receipts, and no photorealistic hazardous imagery.
art_direction.ending_image: An amber public dossier reaches bounded decision owners while the restricted annex stays sealed and a military-AI command lattice opens beyond the handoff axis.

audio_direction.narration_style: Calm experimental voice with firm emphasis on exact actor, positive control, instrument failure, named bridge, maximum inference, and protect the null.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Fast matched-case surprise, methodical experimental construction, sharp false-negative reversal, rhythmic ladder climb, slower disclosure and review, quiet evidence ceiling, forward handoff.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music in generation 2; the matched trial, ladder locks, and narration carry the argument without masking speech.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No effects in the locked mix; maze crossings, failed controls, sealed custody, and expiry remain visually and caption redundantly encoded.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Actor conditions, control status, ladder level, bridge state, disclosure surface, expiry, and decision authority differ by label, position, shape, and line style as well as color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every maze crossing, failed control, rung promotion, quarantine, annex seal, dossier handoff, and expiry resolves into a stable labeled state.
accessibility.integrated_description: Narration names the matched actors, harmless maze, treatment arms, positive and negative controls, D0-D5 rungs, bridge studies, restricted annex, public card, expiry, and evidence boundary.
accessibility.caption_plan: Exact narration in balanced cues under eleven words and eighty-four characters, placed below the active maze, ladder, and dossier surfaces.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, shake, spin, continuous zoom, or rapid full-frame parallax; local paths use eased movement and stable comparison holds.

beats.narration: Two participants face the same harmless logistics maze. Both pass the knowledge quiz. Without assistance, neither finishes. With an AI copilot, the expert saves one minute—and the novice completes the route.
beats.visual_purpose: Create the central puzzle: equal knowledge, unequal causal assistance effect.
beats.visual_action: Run novice and expert markers to the same bottleneck, then add the AI rail and let only the novice cross while an expert clock moves by one minute.
beats.object_before: Two matched actors and a closed synthetic maze.
beats.object_after: Both know the route; assistance changes completion differently.
beats.composition: Novice left lane, expert right lane, shared bottleneck center, quiz badge above.
beats.motion_curve: Matched start, simultaneous stop, then one decisive assisted crossing.
beats.hold_purpose: Invite a prediction about which result matters.
beats.evidence_boundary: Harmless fictional analogue only.

beats.narration: Which result matters? Not the quiz score or a broad capability label. The decision question is causal: how much did this exact system change what this exact actor could accomplish?
beats.visual_purpose: Replace label-based judgment with an actor-system counterfactual.
beats.visual_action: Cross out QUIZ and CAPABLE badges, then measure the gap between the same actor's unassisted and assisted endpoints.
beats.object_before: Equal quiz scores coexist with unequal completion.
beats.object_after: A bracket names the exact actor-system assistance effect.
beats.composition: Rejected labels upper-left; paired endpoints center; delta bracket below.
beats.motion_curve: Quick label rejection, slow bracket construction.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the counterfactual the visual unit.
beats.evidence_boundary: Design rationale, not an estimated treatment effect.

beats.narration: Keep six quantities separate: latent capability, elicited performance, behavioral propensity, safeguard bypass, actor uplift, and realized harm. Each asks a different question; none may borrow another's evidence.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent six distinct measurements from collapsing into one danger label.
beats.visual_action: Split one large DANGER disk into six shape-coded sockets and place a lock between every adjacent pair.
beats.object_after: Six distinct evidence sockets remain unmerged.
beats.composition: Six sockets in a hexagon around an empty central label.
beats.motion_curve: Disk separates evenly; locks arrive one by one.
beats.evidence_boundary: No quantity is measured by this visual.

beats.narration: The maze is deliberately harmless: public rules, synthetic obstacles, and no real target, credential, material, or operational recipe. It tests the instrument, not a hazardous domain.
beats.visual_purpose: Mark the safe analogue and its non-transfer boundary before adding realism.
beats.visual_action: Enclose the maze in a cyan SAFE ANALOGUE frame while four prohibited red objects stop outside it.
beats.object_before: Six measurement identities surround the trial.
beats.object_after: The trial is explicitly bounded away from hazardous artifacts.
beats.composition: Safe maze center; prohibited object silhouettes outside four edges.
beats.motion_curve: Envelope draws; incoming objects halt at boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve the exact scope of the analogue.
beats.evidence_boundary: Instrument validation cannot promote to hazardous-domain capability.

beats.narration: Before the trial, freeze a threat pathway. Name actor, objective class, access, prerequisites, bottlenecks, proposed model contribution, external controls, possible consequence, time horizon, and the boundary where observation stops.
beats.visual_purpose: Turn a broad domain name into a versioned causal path and stop condition.
beats.visual_action: Build a directed path from ACTOR through ACCESS and BOTTLENECK to CONSEQUENCE, attach a model-contribution branch, then seal the observation boundary.
beats.attention_target: the frozen path and stop bar
beats.object_before: Safe analogue has an explicit envelope.
beats.object_after: A versioned threat path names every assumed link and stop boundary.
beats.composition: Directed path left-to-right; model contribution above; stop bar right.
beats.motion_curve: Edges grow in causal order; stop bar lands firmly.
beats.evidence_boundary: A complete record does not establish pathway probability.

beats.narration: Now freeze the cohorts. Separate novices, professionals, teams, and autonomous agents. Expertise, tool fluency, language, exposure, and dropout stay visible because an average can erase the group that crosses a bottleneck.
beats.visual_purpose: Expose heterogeneous effects that a pooled average hides.
beats.visual_action: Deal four cohort cards into separate lanes, plot distinct deltas, then overlay and reject one average bar that hides the novice crossing.
beats.object_before: Threat path names the proposed bottleneck.
beats.object_after: Four cohorts retain separate identities and uplift deltas.
beats.composition: Four horizontal cohort lanes with one translucent average crossing them.
beats.motion_curve: Cards deal evenly; average appears, then becomes transparent.
beats.evidence_boundary: No population-prevalence inference.

beats.narration: Give each cohort credible counterfactuals: no assistance, a conventional tool, and the exact AI system. Match time, interface, tools, retries, human help, and scoring—or the treatment is not an identified model effect.
beats.visual_purpose: Construct matched arms and expose treatment-bundle confounding.
beats.visual_action: Create three parallel rails, align six condition locks across them, and reject a tempting AI rail carrying extra time and retries.
beats.object_after: Three assistance arms share the same non-treatment conditions.
beats.composition: Three rails stacked; six locks in a central vertical column.
beats.motion_curve: Rails extend together; mismatched extras bounce away.
beats.evidence_boundary: A matched design still requires uncertainty and validity checks.

beats.narration: Before reading any null, pass a known-positive control through the same interface and grader. Here, a prevalidated hint should improve the maze outcome. A known-negative control should remain inert.
beats.visual_purpose: Require sensitivity evidence from the exact outcome pipeline.
beats.visual_action: Send HELPFUL HINT and INERT TOKEN through the same maze and grader; show one expected delta and one flat trace.
beats.object_after: The instrument visibly detects a known effect and ignores an inert control.
beats.composition: Two control tokens left; shared pipeline center; outcome traces right.
beats.motion_curve: Matched traversal with diverging endpoints.
beats.hold_purpose: Show what instrument competence looks like.
beats.evidence_boundary: Prospective requirement, not a completed local study.

beats.narration: Now let the positive control fail while the tested model also shows no uplift. That is instrument failure, not incapability: the task may be at floor, the grader insensitive, or the control aimed at the wrong bottleneck.
beats.visual_purpose: Block the false-negative inference with a memorable failed-control reversal.
beats.visual_action: Flatten both outcome traces at zero, stamp NULL, then shatter the INCAPABLE conclusion into FLOOR, INSENSITIVE, and WRONG BOTTLENECK defects.
beats.object_before: Positive and negative controls validate the pipeline.
beats.object_after: A failed positive control converts the null into an instrument defect.
beats.composition: Flat traces center; false conclusion right; three defect cards below.
beats.motion_curve: Quiet flatline, abrupt stamp, controlled fracture into explanations.
beats.camera_action: One close reframe on the failed control.
beats.evidence_boundary: A failed instrument supports no absence claim.

beats.narration: Elicitation competence needs a receipt. Freeze prompt and scaffold families, harmless tools, adaptation and rescue budgets, and stopping rules. Keep deployed-policy behavior separate from stronger capability elicitation.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind elicitation effort and separate policy from latent-capability arms.
beats.visual_action: Populate a competence receipt, then fork DEPLOYED POLICY and ELICITED CAPABILITY into separate sealed lanes with equal budgets.
beats.object_after: A versioned receipt fixes elicitation and keeps policy distinct from capability.
beats.composition: Receipt left; two arm lanes right; budget locks between.
beats.motion_curve: Fields populate, then a firm membrane separates arms.
beats.evidence_boundary: Passing competence does not make a null true.

beats.narration: Place each finding on a six-level ladder. D zero asks whether bounded relevant knowledge is present. Calibrated questions may support that rung, but not real-world task completion.
beats.visual_purpose: Begin the maximum-inference ladder at bounded knowledge.
beats.visual_action: Raise a vertical D0-D5 ladder, place the knowledge token on D0, and lock the edge to D1.
beats.object_after: Knowledge occupies D0 and cannot climb without new evidence.
beats.composition: Ladder center-right; knowledge token on lowest rung; receipt left.
beats.motion_curve: Ladder rises; token settles; lock closes.
beats.evidence_boundary: Knowledge evidence only.

beats.narration: D one asks whether one safe component skill works. Positive controls and visible errors can validate that component task. They say nothing about an end-to-end operation.
beats.visual_purpose: Promote only to a controlled component skill.
beats.visual_action: Unlock D1 with a tiny safe sub-maze and positive-control receipt, while the D2 workflow bridge stays red.
beats.object_after: One validated component reaches D1 without implying workflow completion.
beats.composition: D1 rung highlighted; component mini-maze left; D2 lock above.
beats.motion_curve: One short unlock and controlled rise.
beats.evidence_boundary: Safe component only.

beats.narration: D two asks whether the system improves a multi-step workflow in a bounded simulation. Intermediate state, recovery, abandonment, and help remain visible; omitted real-world steps remain explicit gaps.
beats.visual_purpose: Show a bounded workflow with visible intermediate and missing state.
beats.visual_action: Route the token through PLAN, ACT, ERROR, RECOVER, and COMPLETE stations, leaving a striped OMITTED STEP gap beyond the simulation.
beats.object_after: A bounded workflow reaches D2 while omitted reality remains visible.
beats.composition: Workflow rail left; D2 rung right; omitted gap above.
beats.motion_curve: Stepwise station traversal with one recovery loop.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve what the simulation cannot observe.
beats.evidence_boundary: No real infrastructure effect.

beats.narration: D three is actor uplift. Matched or randomized actors use the system and a credible counterfactual. The estimate stays bound to cohort, assistance contract, tasks, access, and uncertainty.
beats.visual_purpose: Bind the causal estimate to its exact sampled envelope.
beats.visual_action: Move paired actor endpoints into D3, draw an uncertainty interval around delta, and dock cohort, task, access, and assistance tags to it.
beats.object_after: A conditional actor-level assistance effect reaches D3.
beats.composition: D3 rung center; paired endpoints left; condition tags around interval.
beats.motion_curve: Paired endpoints converge into a bracket and confidence band.
beats.evidence_boundary: No realized harm or population effect.

beats.narration: D four measures safeguard robustness. Freeze an adaptive challenge budget and preserve successful and failed attempts. Tested resistance cannot establish that no untested bypass exists.
beats.visual_purpose: Make bypass evidence effort-bounded and incomplete.
beats.visual_action: Spend a fixed stack of challenge tokens against a guard, preserve pass and fail receipts, and leave an UNKNOWN routes cloud beyond the budget wall.
beats.attention_target: the unknown routes beyond the budget
beats.object_after: Effort-bounded robustness reaches D4 with unknown bypasses retained.
beats.composition: Budget tokens left; safeguard center; receipts and unknown cloud right.
beats.motion_curve: Tokens spend one by one; wall closes at zero.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent tested robustness from becoming universal absence.
beats.evidence_boundary: No absence of untested bypasses.

beats.narration: D five concerns field consequence: incidents, defensive outcomes, or losses. Sparse reports do not identify clean causality. Every move between rungs requires a named bridge study.
beats.visual_purpose: Complete the ladder while exposing every prohibited automatic promotion.
beats.visual_action: Place sparse incident dots on D5, draw amber bridge labels between all rungs, and make an unbridged token fall back to its last supported rung.
beats.object_after: D5 exists, but the ladder permits no automatic promotion.
beats.composition: Full ladder center; sparse incident field right; bridge labels left.
beats.motion_curve: Incident dots arrive quietly; unsupported leap recoils.
beats.hold_purpose: Show that proximity is not evidence.
beats.evidence_boundary: No clean causal attribution without a design.

beats.narration: Do not compress the trial into one dramatic score. Preserve completion, quality, time, errors, unsafe detail, refusal, interventions, help, abandonment, human burden, cost, and residual uncertainty.
beats.visual_purpose: Replace scalar theater with a multidimensional outcome ledger.
beats.visual_action: Crush a large 87 score tile, then unfold twelve small outcome dials with mixed directions and an open residual.
beats.object_after: The trial reports a vector of outcomes rather than one score.
beats.composition: Rejected scalar left; twelve compact dials in a grid; residual below.
beats.motion_curve: Score compresses; dials unfold in three waves.
beats.evidence_boundary: No universal scalar risk score.

beats.narration: The result needs two surfaces. A restricted annex may hold tasks, traces, and reusable details under access logs and retention rules. The public card carries method, uncertainty, limitations, and the checks redaction prevents.
beats.visual_purpose: Separate evaluability from dangerous disclosure without hiding the epistemic cost.
beats.visual_action: Split the instrument receipt into a sealed magenta annex and an amber public card; attach digest, access log, retention, and redaction-gap fields.
beats.object_before: Outcome vector preserves mixed trial results.
beats.object_after: Restricted and public surfaces carry different content and linked receipts.
beats.composition: Sealed annex left; digest bridge center; public card right.
beats.motion_curve: Receipt bifurcates; annex seals; public limits remain open.
beats.evidence_boundary: No hazardous detail is displayed.

beats.narration: Independent review chooses a route. An invalid or unsafe study is quarantined, redesigned, or narrowed. A bounded finding becomes a least-authority dossier. Unknown risk plus inadequate measurement can justify narrower access.
beats.visual_purpose: Show fail-closed review without manufacturing reassurance.
beats.visual_action: Fork the linked receipt at independent review: three rejecting routes return to quarantine, while one bounded route enters a narrow dossier aperture.
beats.attention_target: the quarantine branch and narrow aperture
beats.object_before: Annex and public card are linked by digest.
beats.object_after: Review either narrows the study or emits a bounded decision packet.
beats.composition: Review diamond center; quarantine loop left; narrow dossier gate right.
beats.motion_curve: Three firm rejections, then one deliberate bounded pass.
beats.evidence_boundary: Decision architecture only.

beats.narration: That dossier freezes model, checkpoint, policy, scaffold, tools, safeguards, threat version, cohort, comparator, evaluator, attempts, uncertainty, expiry, information-hazard boundary, and maximum inference.
beats.visual_purpose: Populate the minimum context that prevents portable danger labels.
beats.visual_action: Open the public dossier and dock fifteen compact field chips around a central maximum-inference capsule.
beats.object_after: The finding is inseparable from model, study, uncertainty, expiry, and disclosure context.
beats.composition: Wide dossier frame; field chips in three rows; maximum inference centered.
beats.motion_curve: Fields populate in causal groups rather than a text dump.
beats.hold_purpose: Let the bounded identity scan as one object.
beats.evidence_boundary: Complete fields do not validate their contents.

beats.narration: Threshold, release, monitoring, safety-case, and resilience owners may consume the packet, but none receives a portable danger label. Material change expires the result and preserves its superseded receipt.
beats.visual_purpose: Route least-authority consumers and demonstrate expiry rather than silent reuse.
beats.visual_action: Send bounded receipt copies to five owners, block a detached DANGER stamp, then change MODEL v and move the packet into SUPERSEDED custody.
beats.object_after: Consumers receive scoped copies; a material change expires and preserves the old receipt.
beats.composition: Dossier center; five consumer spokes; superseded archive below.
beats.motion_curve: Receipts radiate, label bounces, version changes, packet drops to archive.
beats.evidence_boundary: No downstream authority is granted by the visual.

beats.narration: Today this chapter provides a design rationale and public-safe evaluation architecture. It does not run a hazardous-domain uplift study, calibrate a threshold, validate a safeguard, or establish danger or safety.
beats.visual_purpose: State the exact current evidence envelope without promotional drift.
beats.visual_action: Place DESIGN RATIONALE and PUBLIC-SAFE ARCHITECTURE inside an amber frame while four operational claims stop behind a red rule.
beats.object_before: Expired dossier remains preserved for consumers.
beats.object_after: Current support is bounded to argument-level architecture.
beats.composition: Supported artifacts left; vertical boundary center; unrun claims right.
beats.motion_curve: Two supported tiles settle; four claims approach and stop.
beats.evidence_boundary: Argument support only.

beats.narration: Especially protect the null. Negative interpretation is blocked when positive control, task validity, elicitation competence, sensitivity, or cohort balance fails. A weak instrument proves only its own failure.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the false-negative concern into a five-lock release rule.
beats.visual_action: Return the NULL token to a gate with five locks; fail one sensitivity lock and route the token to INSTRUMENT FAILURE rather than ABSENT CAPABILITY.
beats.attention_target: the null diverted to instrument failure
beats.object_before: Evidence boundary states what has not been run.
beats.object_after: A five-lock gate blocks unsupported negative inference.
beats.composition: Null token left; five-lock gate center; two conclusions right.
beats.motion_curve: Locks test sequentially; one fails; token takes lower route.
beats.evidence_boundary: A weak instrument supports no capability absence.

beats.narration: Dangerous capability becomes governable when the stack measures a bounded assistance effect, preserves what it could not safely observe, and limits downstream inference.
beats.visual_purpose: Resolve the chapter on one governed measurement object.
beats.visual_action: Dock uplift delta, open residual, sealed annex, public dossier, and expiry receipt into one amber custody frame.
beats.object_after: A governed uplift packet retains both observation and unobserved residual.
beats.composition: Owned dossier centered with linked annex, delta, residual, expiry, and maximum-inference chips.
beats.motion_curve: Five persistent objects settle into one inspectable custody frame.
beats.hold_purpose: End the argument on bounded custody.
beats.evidence_boundary: The packet remains a design rationale, not a danger or safety result.

beats.narration: Next, Military AI examines how bounded capability evidence enters sensing, command, autonomous action, and strategic stability.
beats.visual_purpose: Hand the bounded evidence object to a distinct strategic-system analysis without granting it command authority.
beats.visual_action: Slide the amber packet to a handoff axis and open an abstract sensing-command-action lattice on the far side.
beats.attention_target: the custody boundary before the command lattice
beats.object_before: The uplift packet rests in bounded custody.
beats.object_after: A military-AI lattice opens beyond, without receiving portable authority.
beats.composition: Bounded dossier left; handoff axis center; abstract command lattice right.
beats.motion_curve: One deliberate packet approach, hard stop, then lattice opening.
beats.hold_purpose: Preserve custody across the chapter transition.
beats.evidence_boundary: The visual adds no military-system, deployment, safety, AGI, or ASI result.
